_comment: The three film series. 'description' is the existing project-card copy from the live projects.html, verbatim. Order here is the display order. 'featured' = the film pinned as the opening card of /projects (always visible, not affected by filters).

series.name: Show Me Türkiye
series.label: Flagship Series
series.description: Our main cinematic series exploring the most breathtaking destinations, hidden valleys, and ancient cities across Türkiye.

series.name: Let Me Show You Türkiye
series.label: Travel Series
series.description: A personal journey through Türkiye's culture, food, and people - intimate stories from the ground up, told with authenticity.

series.name: Skies of Türkiye
series.label: Aerial Series
series.description: A bird's-eye perspective of Türkiye's dramatic landscapes - from volcanic plateaus to turquoise coastlines, all from above.
